hypothesis: With the same experts on the card in every step, on a card holding part of the experts, the change gives the same logits.
command: git apply docs/experiments/qwen36-cuda-chain-coalesce-2026-10-25/no-swap.patch && cd c && make qwen36_tier.o backend_cuda.o cuda_chain.o cu_xb.o cu_tier.o CUDA=1 CUDA_ARCH=sm_89 && gcc -O3 -march=native -fopenmp -pthread -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-unused-function -DCOLI_CUDA -I. ../docs/experiments/qwen36-cuda-chain-coalesce-2026-10-25/bench.c qwen36_tier.o backend_cuda.o cuda_chain.o cu_xb.o cu_tier.o -o qwen36-bench -lm -fopenmp -pthread -L/usr/local/cuda/lib64 -Wl,-rpath,/usr/local/cuda/lib64 -lcudart -lcublasLt -lcublas -lstdc++; env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=/root LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib64-nvidia COLI_CUDA=1 COLI_GPUS=0 CUDA_EXPERT_GB=auto OMP_WAIT_POLICY=ACTIVE OMP_PROC_BIND=close CUDA_EXPERT_GB=5 COLI_CUDA_CHAIN_PROMOTE=0 QT_DIAG_NOSWAP=1 ./qwen36-bench --model <model> --text <dir>/promessi_sposi.txt --lengths 64,512 --gen 32 --teacher --steps <steps file>

hardware.cpu: Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU @ 2.20GHz (6 cores / 12 threads, 38.5 MiB L3) + NVIDIA L4 (23034 MiB, sm_89)
hardware.storage: Google Colab VM disk (the model downloaded to /content before the runs, then read once into the page cache)
hardware.os: Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, Linux 6.6.122+ x86_64 (Google Colab), CUDA 13.0 (nvcc V13.0.88), driver 580.82.07, gcc (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 13.3.0

quality.method: make -C c check (macOS arm64) and make -C c cuda-chain-check cuda-test CUDA=1 CUDA_ARCH=sm_89 (L4) pass; every run of both versions gives the same fingerprint of every logit and token (FNV-1a: 0c4badd66f81428e at 64 tokens, f42695c4fc1b0cc3 at 512) and the same teacher-forced nll (the same experts on the card in every step: an expert gives slightly different values on the host and on the card, so the logits depend on where each one was)
